Added a1-vocabulary and a2-vocabulary as named profiles (same bounds as a1-grammar/a2-grammar) so all 19 combinations are now covered by a named profile or the deferred list, and updated the stale '17 combinations' assertion in tests/unit/production-quiz-profiles.test.js to 19.
_decision_log.rationale: This is a documentation/config catch-up for an already-shipped, already-tested content policy (Agent 72), not a new content or QA-behavior change — A1/A2 Grammar/Vocabulary ratios remain governed by CQ-B07 regardless of this file.
